directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: I didn't realize Monolith had its own traders?
entries.JA_current: I didn't realize Monolith had its own traders?
entries.JA_new: モノリスにも専属の商人がいるとは知らなかった。

entries.EN: You are only partially correct, stalker. I trade all sorts of gear and supplies with the Monolithians, but I'm not one of them. Now, you're probably curious how it came to be that I was permitted to stay here and didn't get killed on sight, right? Don't ask, trust me.. Just a hint: these Monolith followers are not quite the "fanatics" that they seem. They just have their own ... patrons, is all.

entries.JA_new: 半分は当たりだ、ストーカー。俺はモノリスの連中と装備や物資を取引してるが、仲間ってわけじゃない。どうしてここにいられて、見つけ次第殺されずに済んでるのか気になるだろ？ 詮索はよしてくれ。俺を信じな。ひとつだけ言っておくと、あいつらは見た目ほどの「狂信者」じゃない。後ろ盾がいるのさ……それだけだ。

entries.EN: And what about the Brain Scorcher? The radar antennae are just down the road from here!
entries.JA_current: And what about the Brain Scorcher? The radar antennae are just down the road from here!
entries.JA_new: それで、ブレイン・スコーチャーはどうなんだ？ レーダーのアンテナはすぐそこだろ？

entries.EN: I have this special helmet from my "friends" among the "big wigs" here. Don't go trying anything funny though - it will self-destruct as soon as you try to remove it, most likely tearing off your hands in the process. Oh, believe me, these "friends" of mine know how to defend their technology. By the way, my ... employer... has asked me to tell you that you should be careful near the reactor. He may contact you himself in the future, but for now he asked me to convey his message to you: "Not everything that seems obvious to us is obvious indeed"...

entries.JA_new: ここのお偉方の中にいる「友人」から、特別なヘルメットを手に入れた。だが、妙な真似はするなよ。外そうとすればすぐ自爆する。手まで吹き飛ぶかもしれん。あの「友人」たちは自分たちの技術を守る術を心得てる。信じていい。それと、俺の……雇い主から伝言だ。炉の近くでは用心しろとな。いずれ本人から連絡があるかもしれないが、今はこれだけ伝えてくれと言われた。『明らかに見えることが、本当に明らかとは限らない』……

entries.EN: Man, you traders really make me laugh, you'll infiltrate your way into any place, no matter how fucked up it is! I'm at a loss for words at this point!
entries.JA_current: Man, you traders really make me laugh, you'll infiltrate your way into any place, no matter how fucked up it is! I'm at a loss for words at this point!
entries.JA_new: ったく、商人ってのは笑わせてくれるな。どんなヤバい場所にも入り込むんだから！ もう何て言えばいいのか分からねえよ！
